title: The leak_scan extension point still declares file_hits without the root parameter that kbpublic now passes
goal: kbext's leak_scan point declares file_hits(path, text, allow, pinned=(), root=None); its sample passes the root, so verify calls a file_hits extender that takes it

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import kbext; p=[x for x in kbext.SURFACE["points"] if x["name"]=="leak_scan"][0]; sys.exit(0 if "root=None" in p["signature"] else "not yet: leak_scan declares "+p["signature"])

repro_reason: nothing wires the extension point yet, so the declared signature can only be compared with the function's

run:
import json,subprocess,sys,tempfile,pathlib
T=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
e=T/"ext"; e.mkdir()
(e/"gleak.py").write_text("KBEXT_REQUIRES = \">=0.1\"\ndef file_hits(path, text, allow, pinned=(), root=None):\n    assert root is not None\n    return []\n")
(T/"settings.json").write_text(json.dumps({"extensions":{"leak_scan":"gleak:file_hits"},"extension_paths":[str(e)]}))
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbext.py","verify","--root",str(T)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300)
sys.exit(0 if r.returncode==0 else "not yet: "+r.stdout[-600:])
